claudeStatusBar.tokenBudget.markdownDescription: Your own token budget for the 5-hour window (input + output, cache excluded). `0` means no budget: the value is shown without a percentage. This is a pacing target you choose — Anthropic does not publish token quotas. The real 5-hour and weekly usage is read from Claude Code automatically.

claudeStatusBar.costBudget.markdownDescription: Your own cost budget in USD for the 5-hour window. `0` means no budget.

claudeStatusBar.messageBudget.markdownDescription: Your own message budget for the 5-hour window. `0` means no budget.

claudeStatusBar.notifications.sessionEnd.description: Show notification when session timer reaches zero

claudeStatusBar.showContextInStatusBar.description: Show the current (or last active) Claude Code session context usage in the status bar

claudeStatusBar.showContextAsCircle.description: Show the current context percentage with a circular indicator in the status bar

claudeStatusBar.showProjectName.description: Show workspace/project name in the statistics popup

claudeStatusBar.showRemainingPercentage.description: Show remaining percentage instead of consumed percentage for context, 5-hour/7-day usage, and configured budgets
